Creates character reference portraits and book plate graphics.
Screenplay reasoning, shot planning, and cast analysis.

models.notes: Also uses videos/extensions for clip continue. Official list price $0.050/s. 1080p $0.25 is NOT official for this id (native 1080p belongs to grok-imagine-video-1.5). aspect_ratio/resolution are NOT accepted on videos/extensions — the extension output always matches the source clip's aspect ratio (docs.x.ai).

models.notes: Catalog role bundle. generate is grok-imagine-video-1.5; extend is grok-imagine-video. This virtual id is never sent to the provider as model. Extra role keys (for example voice) are legal and ignored until routed.

Prompt-based edit of an already-generated clip via POST videos/edits: takes an existing video + a text instruction, returns a new video. This catalog id is NOT an official xAI model id — the official edit path uses grok-imagine-video. Id left unchanged because the app's video-edit capability default and clients key on grok-imagine-video-edit. Output always inherits the source clip's duration and resolution (not independently configurable) and input is capped at 8.7s by xAI. video can be a Files API file_id or a url/data URI.
models.pricingNotes: xAI has not published a separate edit model or edit-specific price as of 2026-08-15. Official edit path is grok-imagine-video. videoCostPerSecondByResolution is proxied from grok-imagine-video generation rates (1080p $0.25 dropped — not official). Labeled estimate only.

models.notes: Open-weights 13B DiT video generation model hosted on Fal.ai serverless GPUs. Billed as a flat ~$0.40/video (frame-count-based generation, not duration-based) — NOT per-second. Official resolutions 480p / 580p / 720p only (no 1080p). Single init/reference image only (true i2v). Real API parameter is num_frames (85 or 129) + fps, not seconds — represented via shortClipFrameCount/longClipFrameCount. numInferenceSteps default 30 confirmed against fal.ai/models/fal-ai/hunyuan-video/api. Supports 16:9 or 9:16.
models.pricingNotes: fal.ai hunyuan-video 2026-08-15: $0.40/video (unchanged). Official resolutions 480p/580p/720p only.

models.notes: Tencent Hunyuan Video 1.5 text-to-video on Fal.ai. Official param is num_frames (1–121, default 121), not seconds — seconds here are a planning bound. numInferenceSteps default 28. models.pricingNotes: fal.ai/models/fal-ai/hunyuan-video-v1.5/text-to-video 2026-08-15: $0.075/s (listing figure matches I2V $0.075/s).

Requires an ElevenLabs API key with Instant Voice Cloning permission (create_instant_voice_clone). Keys without that scope return 401 missing_permissions — switch to fal-ai/minimax/voice-clone or upgrade the key.

Clones a voice from a reference sample (>=10s, reuses this project's existing assets/characters/{key}/voice_clone_sample.* upload) via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/minimax/voice-clone). Input: audio_url (URL or data URI). Output: custom_voice_id, reused across many fal-ai/minimax/speech-02-hd calls so the clone cost is paid once. $1.50 per clone call — confirmed via fal.ai's own model/pricing page and openapi schema (2026-08). A preview-text option exists ($0.30/1000 chars) but this app's client never requests it. MiniMax retains the cloned voice only if used by a speech call at least once within 7 days of creation (provider-side retention, not enforced by this app).

Text-to-speech via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/minimax/speech-02-hd) using a voice cloned by fal-ai/minimax/voice-clone (custom_voice_id passed as voice_setting.voice_id — confirmed against MiniMax's own platform.minimax.io voice-cloning docs, same convention). Input: text (max 5000 chars per call, this app does not auto-chunk longer narration), voice_setting {voice_id, speed 0.5-2.0, vol, pitch, emotion}. Output: audio.url + duration_ms. $0.10 per 1000 characters — confirmed via fal.ai's own model/pricing page (2026-08).

models.notes: Sync Labs Lipsync 2 Pro via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2/pro). Input: video_url, audio_url (both URL or data URI), optional sync_mode (cut_off default | loop | bounce | silence | remap) for when the two durations differ. Output: video.url. Zero-shot — no fine-tuning needed; preserves natural teeth/facial detail per Fal's own listing. ~$5/min of output video (~$0.083/s) — sourced via targeted search during research (fal.ai's own pricing page returned HTTP 429 rate-limiting when fetched directly; cross-checked against Sync Labs' own sync.so/pricing page, which lists the same figure for their Pro tier). Confirm against fal.ai's live pricing page before relying on this for a large narration/dub run.

Newest Sync Labs model on Fal.ai (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v3), same core video_url/audio_url/sync_mode input as v2 Pro plus an optional `options` object (model_mode, prompt, temperature, active_speaker_detection, occlusion_detection_enabled) that this app's client does not yet expose.
